name: Nightmare Terrain

stealth.note: DC 22 Perception check to detect the subtle magical aura of the land

description: What seems like an innocent stretch of land assaults trespassers with terrible illusions.
disable: DC 22 Arcana check, DC 22 Nature check, DC 22 Occultism check, or DC 22 Religion check (by a hero with expert proficiency in that skill) three times to temporarily disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, DC 25)
reset: The terrible visions cease after all creatures have left the affected area, but the hazard is immediately ready to inflict its visions on the next creature to enter.
routine:
(1 action) Terrible visions assail the minds of all creatures who can see within the affected area. Each creature must attempt a DC 24 Will save saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 2.

Failure The creature takes 2d8+9 mental damage and is Frightened 3.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8+18 mental damage and is Frightened 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Step into Nightmares
offensiveAbilities.description: If a creature that can see moves 10 feet into the affected area, the hazard rolls Stealth (+16) for its initiative.
